choose: Retain exact result in a record
saved: Save this calculation before retaining its result.
unsupported: Retain a saved independent exact result from engines 2, 3 or 4, or a finite real computational approximation from engine 4. Units and unsupported results are unavailable.
scope: The selected saved expression is evaluated with its pinned engine and policy. The retained value is exact; the displayed decimal is not used.
title: {name} - expression {number}
completed: Exact result retained. Its saved recipe remains available independently of the calculator.
cancelled: Preparation cancelled. The captured recipe is retained; retry uses the same input.
background: Preparation continues while the destination is unlocked. Find it under Evidence & analysis in the selected record.
backgroundCompleted: Find the retained dataset and captured recipe under Evidence & analysis in the selected record.
backgroundStopped: The captured recipe remains available. Retry uses the same saved input.
invalid: The result response does not match the selected destination.
repeatHelp: Repeat evaluates this captured expression and policy again. It creates new immutable recipe and dataset revisions; it does not read newer calculator edits.
chooseApproximate: Retain approximate result in a record
scopeApproximate: The selected saved expression is evaluated with its pinned engine, working precision and rounding policy. The complete computational decimal is retained, not the display-rounded text. It remains an approximation; no error bound is inferred.
completedApproximate: Approximate result retained with its computation label and pinned recipe.
